description: Lava flow and affected structures caused by Nyiragongo volcanic eruption, Nord-Kivu Province, DR Congo is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). UNOSAT code: VO20210523COD This map illustrates potentially affected structures and buildings in Nyiragongo district, Nord-Kivu province, DR Congo as detected by satellite image acquired after the eruption of Mount Nyiragongo volcano on 22 May 2021. UNITAR-UNOSAT analysis used a TerraSAR-X image acquired on 24 May 2021, at 16:13 UTC, to observe the lava flow. Coverage: Democratic Republic of the Congo. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT). Its tags are geodata, natural disasters. It offers 2 resource(s) in GEODATABASE, SHP. The portal shows 2026-07-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-SA (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
